# cloptima_llm_unit_economics_denominator (Resource)

Configures a business unit, such as a resolved support ticket, used as the denominator when measuring LLM cost per unit.

~> **Importing:** Denominator settings are imported by `unit_type` (e.g. `terraform import cloptima_llm_unit_economics_denominator.example support_ticket_resolved`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cloptima_llm_unit_economics_denominator" "monthly_active_users" {
  unit_type           = "monthly_active_user"
  display_name        = "Monthly Active User"
  description         = "Denominator for calculating LLM inference cost per active user"
  default_granularity = "monthly"
  default_group_by    = "app_id"
  is_default          = true
}

resource "cloptima_llm_unit_economics_denominator" "completed_order" {
  unit_type           = "completed_order"
  display_name        = "Completed Checkout Order"
  description         = "Denominator for calculating AI copilot cost per completed purchase"
  default_granularity = "daily"
  default_group_by    = "team_id"
  is_default          = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `display_name` (String) Display name for this business unit, up to 160 characters.
- `unit_type` (String) Lowercase business unit identifier (e.g. support_ticket_resolved), up to 96 characters.

### Optional

- `default_granularity` (String) Default reporting granularity: daily, weekly, or monthly. Defaults to daily.
- `default_group_by` (String) Default dimension to group unit economics reports by (e.g. app_id, team_id, model). Defaults to app_id.
- `description` (String) How this unit maps to customer value, up to 1024 characters.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the organization's default unit. Defaults to false.
- `metadata` (String) Optional metadata, as a JSON object.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `customer_id` (String) Owning customer ID.
- `id` (String) Denominator setting ID.
- `observed` (Boolean) Whether usage has been reported for this unit type.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.
